title: Admin - Comment Moderation - Search Moderation Content - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin Comment Moderation - Search Moderation Content feature on the Y4J platform. This feature allows Admins to search moderation items by author, product, or content text with partial text match (from 3 characters), working across all content types and respecting selected filters. Covers search functionality, partial matching, filter integration, edge cases, and empty state.

testCases.title: Search input is visible and accepts text
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Comment Moderation page is loaded.
expectedResults: A search input field is visible on the page
The field is clickable and gains focus
Typed text appears in the field
The field has a placeholder indicating search purpose

testCases.title: Search by author name returns matching results
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Moderation items with known author names exist.
steps: Type an author name (3+ characters) in the search field
expectedResults: Results filter to show only items matching the author name
Matching cards display the searched author name
Non-matching items are hidden
The result count updates
testCases.postconditions: Search by author returns correct results

testCases.title: Search by product name returns matching results
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Moderation items associated with known products exist.
steps: Type a product name (3+ characters) in the search field
expectedResults: Results filter to show only items matching the product name
Matching cards display the searched product name
Non-matching items are hidden
testCases.postconditions: Search by product returns correct results

testCases.title: Search by content text returns matching results
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Moderation items with known content text exist.
steps: Type a phrase from content text (3+ characters) in the search field
expectedResults: Results filter to show items whose content contains the search text
Matching cards display content containing the searched phrase
Non-matching items are hidden
testCases.postconditions: Search by content text returns correct results

testCases.title: Search supports partial text match from 3 characters
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Moderation items exist.
steps: Type 2 characters in the search field
expectedResults: At 2 characters, no filtering occurs (or full list remains)
At 3 characters, results begin filtering dynamically
Partial matches are returned (not just exact matches)
Results narrow as more characters are typed
testCases.postconditions: Partial match from 3 characters is confirmed

testCases.title: Search works across all content types (Query, Review, Vendor Response)
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Items of different content types exist with similar text.
steps: Type a search query that matches items across different content types
expectedResults: Results include matching items from Queries, Reviews, AND Vendor Responses
Search is not limited to a single content type
All matching items regardless of type are displayed

testCases.title: Search respects selected status filter
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Status filter is applied (e.g., 'Needs Review').
steps: Type a search query in the search field
expectedResults: Results are filtered by BOTH the status filter AND the search query
Only items matching both criteria are shown
The search does not override or clear the status filter
Combined filtering works correctly

testCases.title: Search respects selected content type filter
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Content type filter is applied (e.g., 'Reviews only').
expectedResults: Results are filtered by BOTH the type filter AND the search query
Only items matching both criteria are shown
The search respects the type filter

testCases.title: No results found shows empty state
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Moderation items exist.
steps: Type a search query that matches no items (e.g., 'xyznonexistent123')
expectedResults: No moderation cards are displayed
An empty state message is shown (e.g., 'No results found')
The message is clearly visible
The search field still contains the typed query
testCases.postconditions: Empty state is displayed for no-match search

testCases.title: Special characters in search are supported
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Moderation items exist.
steps: Type special characters in the search field (e.g., '@', '#', '&', '!')
expectedResults: Special characters are accepted in the search field
No errors or crashes occur
Results are filtered based on the special character search
The search handles special characters gracefully

testCases.title: Very long search query is supported
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin.
steps: Type a very long search query (100+ characters)
expectedResults: The long query is accepted in the search field
No errors or crashes occur
Results are filtered (or empty state shown if no match)
The search field handles long input gracefully
testCases.postconditions: Long search queries are handled correctly

testCases.title: Clearing search restores full list
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Search has been performed with filtered results.
steps: Perform a search that filters results
Clear the search field (select all + delete or clear button)
expectedResults: After clearing search, the full moderation list is restored
All items that were previously visible are shown again
No page refresh is required
Any active filters (status/type) remain applied
testCases.postconditions: Full list is restored after clearing search

testCases.title: Search is case-insensitive
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Moderation items with known text exist.
steps: Type a search query in lowercase
Clear and type the same query in uppercase
expectedResults: Both lowercase and uppercase searches return the same results
Search is case-insensitive
Mixed case also returns the same results

testCases.title: Search results update dynamically as user types
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Moderation items exist.
steps: Type characters one at a time in the search field (starting from 3rd character)
expectedResults: Results update dynamically as each character is typed (after 3 chars)
No page reload occurs
Results narrow progressively with more characters
The filtering is real-time
